answer: An operator running 161 keys therefore burns for 161 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Because the gale salt is published after the basalt checkpoint, the zephyr audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 118 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
